# TEST INSTRUCTIONS — V35 — Gate 5 evidence — BASH (MINGW64)

## EXECUTOR CONTRACT — read this before anything else

**Entry instruction from the owner:** *"Open TEST-INSTRUCTIONS.md at repo root and follow it."*
Follow it as written. It is a specification, not a suggestion.

### C1. Bash only — MINGW64

Never PowerShell. Never `cmd.exe`. Never `chcp`, `findstr`, `dir`, `gradlew.bat`, `if not exist`,
`timeout /t`. If you typed `dir`, you are in the wrong shell.

### C2. Do not edit this file

Do not add rules, do not rename branches, do not "improve" the steps, do not delete sections.
Local edits break the tie between what was written and what was actually run. If something in here
is wrong, **report that** — do not patch it.

### C3. Do not analyse or fix local code — this is not your job

Not the app code, not the test code, not the build files, not `local.properties`. You run commands,
you record what happened, you write the report. That is the whole job.

### C4. If anything goes wrong running the specified tests: STOP and REPORT

Do not diagnose. Do not repair. Do not retry with your own variation. Do not "work around" it.
**STOP**, and put it in the test report with:

- the exact command you ran
- the shell and working directory (`pwd`)
- the full output, verbatim — no summary, no paraphrase
- the exit code (`echo "exit=$?"`)
- the commit SHA (`git log -1 --oneline`)

It is not your job to fix any issue.

### C5. "No output" is not "not found"

Check the exit code before concluding anything is missing:

| exit | meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | found / success |
| `1` | genuinely absent |
| `127` | **the command itself did not run — wrong shell** |

Reporting "the fix is not present" when the truth is "grep does not exist in cmd.exe" is exactly the
false alarm that wasted a whole round. See §0b.

**Signature of a command that leaked to `cmd.exe`:**

```
'<something>' is not recognized as an internal or external command
```

That wording only ever comes from `cmd.exe`. A genuine bash failure says
`bash: <something>: command not found`. If you see the `cmd.exe` wording, the command did not run in
the shell you think it did — report the shell mismatch, do not work around it.

### C6. No fabrication, no placeholders

Every value in the report must be real command output. `<...>`, `$(...)`, `(unknown)`, `..`, and
guessed versions are rejections.

### C7. Anti-loop

On failure: do **not** fetch, checkout, pull and re-run the world. Report and STOP. The flake
protocol (§5b) permits exactly one rerun of the failed class, and nothing else.

## 0.0 ENVIRONMENT — VERIFY, DO NOT ASSUME

The owner's Git Bash terminal has `adb` and `java` on `PATH` already:

```
which adb  -> /c/Users/thiss/AppData/Local/Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb
PATH       -> /mingw64/bin:/usr/bin:...:/c/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-17.0.16.8-hotspot/bin:...:/c/Users/thiss/AppData/Local/Android/Sdk/platform-tools
```

So **assume nothing is broken.** Prove it, and only intervene if a check fails.

### 0.0.1 Prove the shell you are actually in

```bash
echo "$BASH_VERSION"
echo "pwd=$(pwd)"
which adb
which java
which grep
```

| Result | Meaning |
|---|---|
| all four print paths | environment is fine — **go to §0 and skip 0.0.2** |
| `which adb` prints nothing | adb genuinely not on this shell's `PATH` |
| `'X' is not recognized as an internal or external command` | you are in **cmd.exe** — wrong shell, stop |
| `bash: X: command not found` | bash, but `PATH` is short — go to 0.0.2 |

### 0.0.2 ONLY IF a check above failed

```bash
. ./scripts/env.sh
```

**The leading dot matters.** `./scripts/env.sh` runs it in a child shell and every export is thrown
away on exit. `.` is a bash builtin, so it works even when `PATH` is broken.

It rebuilds the login `PATH`, resolves `JAVA_HOME`, derives `ANDROID_HOME` from `adb`, and prints a
per-tool PASS/FAIL. If it still ends `CHECKS FAILED`, **STOP** and report the `[FAIL]` lines (C3/C4).

### 0.0.3 `JAVA_HOME`, if and only if gradle complains about it

```bash
echo "$JAVA_HOME"
```

`/mnt/c/...` is a **WSL** path and will not work in Git Bash. Correct form:

```bash
export JAVA_HOME="/c/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-17.0.16.8-hotspot"
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
```

If gradle does not complain, leave `JAVA_HOME` alone.

### 0.0.4 Everything later goes in this same window

`export`s do not survive a new terminal.

## 0a. PROVE YOU ARE IN BASH — do this first, before anything else

```bash
echo "$BASH_VERSION"
command -v grep
```

- `echo "$BASH_VERSION"` must print something like `5.2.37(1)-release`.
- `command -v grep` must print a path like `/usr/bin/grep`.

**If either prints nothing, or you get `command not found`, you are in `cmd.exe` / PowerShell.**
Every `grep` in this file then silently produces no output, which looks exactly like "the thing
being searched for is missing". Stop, open **Git Bash (MINGW64)**, and start again.

`dir` is a CMD command. If you typed `dir`, you are in the wrong shell.

### 0b. How to tell "grep found nothing" from "grep did not run"

```bash
grep -n "61 allowed" app/src/main/java/com/example/fdmanager/ui/screens/OnboardingScreen.kt
echo "exit=$?"
```

| Result | Meaning | Action |
|---|---|---|
| a line `130: ...` and `exit=0` | fix present | carry on |
| no line and `exit=1` | genuinely absent | STOP and report |
| `grep: command not found`, `exit=127` | **wrong shell** | switch to MINGW64, do NOT report a missing fix |

A missing fix and a missing `grep` are **not** the same thing. Only `exit=1` means the fix is gone.

## 0. Sync — record the SHA

```bash
cd /c/LocalApps/AppDevelopment/fd-manager/fixed-deposit-manager-android
echo $BASH_VERSION

git fetch origin --prune
git checkout -B test-run origin/arena/b64e0abe-fixed-deposit-manager-android
git log -1 --oneline
git status --short
```

### The local branch is called `test-run` on purpose

It is named after the **source**, never after a SHA. A branch called `test-472867b` that actually
contains seven later commits is a lie, and that is exactly the mix-up that already happened —
the runbook said `test-472867b` while the tree was at `93d4e7e`.

The SHA is not in the name. It is what `git log -1` prints, and that is what goes in the report.

### Mandatory: prove local HEAD equals the remote head

```bash
git rev-parse --short HEAD
git rev-parse --short origin/arena/b64e0abe-fixed-deposit-manager-android
```

**These two must be identical.** If they differ, your checkout is stale — run the three commands
again before doing anything else. Every later step depends on this, and a stale tree silently
tests the wrong code.

### Mandatory: confirm the file you are reading matches the tree

```bash
ls -la TEST-INSTRUCTIONS.md
git status --short
```

`git status --short` must be **empty**. If `TEST-INSTRUCTIONS.md` shows as modified, someone edited
the local copy — restore it before continuing:

```bash
git checkout -- TEST-INSTRUCTIONS.md
```

Prove the fix is present before spending four minutes:

```bash
grep -n "31 LFC = 61 allowed" app/src/main/java/com/example/fdmanager/ui/screens/OnboardingScreen.kt
```

Must hit. If it prints nothing, you are on the wrong commit — stop.

### 5a. Capture the log IMMEDIATELY, in bash

```bash
adb logcat -d | grep -i "TestRunner" > test-artifacts-v35/logcat-v35.txt
wc -l test-artifacts-v35/logcat-v35.txt
grep -c "TestRunner" test-artifacts-v35/logcat-v35.txt
```

**Both numbers must be greater than 0.** If zero, the buffer lost the run — go back to §3 and redo.

Sanity-check the encoding (a UTF-16 file from PowerShell is a rejection):

```bash
head -c 2 test-artifacts-v35/logcat-v35.txt | od -An -tx1
```

`ff fe` means UTF-16 → wrong, regenerate with the bash command above.

### 5b. Anti-loop

On failure: do NOT fetch/checkout/pull and loop. Report and STOP. Flake rerun, once:

```bash
./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest \
  -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.class=com.example.fdmanager.<ClassName> --rerun-tasks
```

## 6. Screenshots — get past onboarding FIRST, then one at a time

V34's four captures were all the **onboarding screen**, because the app opens on onboarding after a
fresh install and nothing navigated past it. Tap through before capturing anything.

```bash
./gradlew installDebug
adb shell am start -n com.vssbox.fdmanager/com.example.fdmanager.MainActivity
sleep 5
adb shell dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus     # must show com.vssbox.fdmanager
```

> Home screen with FD cards."**
> Wait for the owner. Do not capture the welcome screen.

adb shell screencap -p /sdcard/probe.png
adb pull /sdcard/probe.png test-artifacts-v35/_probe.png

### 6a. Prove they are four different screens

```bash
rm -f test-artifacts-v35/_probe.png
md5sum test-artifacts-v35/*.png
md5sum test-artifacts-v35/*.png | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | wc -l     # must print 4
ls -la test-artifacts-v35/*.png                                          # each > 20 KB
```

Fewer than 4 distinct hashes = a screen was not changed. Redo that one capture.
